fact: At a police forum in Omdurman on 9 June 2026 the Sudan police said 103 police facilities had been sabotaged or destroyed in the war, that its 2024-2030 plan of 21 programmes and 39 projects includes developing digital systems, and that police databases had been restored.
title: الشرطة تكشف عن رقم صادم لحجم المنشات المتضررة
